title: Annotatio VI §.V instantia: Edite may cover bread oral + body spiritual (+ their third oral-body)
pass_a_gloss: You press: Then the Mandate of the Holy Supper’s Institution, Eat, will obtain a double sense, commanding two modes of eating — Corporal or Oral of the blessed Bread, and Spiritual of Christ’s body. Reply: Conceding the whole, as not only not absurd but almost necessary, because of the double food offered in Christ’s mandate — one Corporal, the other Spiritual — and therefore to be granted by those themselves who form this instantia, nay amplified by them in a third sense when they contend that Christ’s mandate Eat comprehends first the Oral mode of eating bread, second the Spiritual of eating Christ’s body, and finally third the Sacramental or Oral mode of eating Christ’s body likewise.
pass_b_english: Press: then “Eat” has a double sense — oral of blessed bread and spiritual of Christ’s body.
Concede that — almost necessary given two foods in the mandate. Those who press the point even add a third: sacramental/oral eating of the body as well.
source_text: Instas: Ita Mandatum Institutionis S. Cœnæ, Edite, duplicem obtinebit sensum, duos scil. edendi modos imperans, Corporalem scil. seu Oralem Panis benedicti, & Spiritualem corporis Christi. Respond. Concedendo totum, ceu non tantum non absurdum, sed penè necessarium, ob duplicem mandatô Christi oblatum cibum, Corporalem unum, alterum Spiritualem, ideoque ab iis ipsis, qui hanc instantiam formant, largiendum, quin tertio sensu ab iis ampliatum, quando primò, Oralem manducandi panis, secundo, Spiritualem manducandi corporis Christi, denique tertiò Sacramentalem seu Oralem manducandi itidem corporis Christi, Modum, mandatô Christi, Edite, comprehendi contendunt.
